chunks: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Do not place complete trust in your brother, for indeed the fall caused by over-reliance can never be recovered from.

key_terms.الاسترسال: Over-reliance, letting one's guard down completely, unguarded openness
key_terms.تستقال: To be pardoned, recovered from, or undone (from istiqala)
key_terms.صرعة: A fall, downfall, stumble caused by being thrown down

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Sadiq say about trusting others completely?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) advises prudent caution in interpersonal relationships. This teaching, delivered at a gathering in the Mashhad of Imam al-Rida, warns that placing unconditional trust in others, even one's close associates, can lead to irreparable harm. The term 'istirsal' (over-reliance) was understood by the original audience as letting one's guard down completely, which classical scholars recognized as distinct from healthy trust built through experience.
